measurement_scope: Housing plus nozzle only. Front width is user-rounded 18 mm (photo display 18.02). Not a diameter or full length replacement. Elbow and tube excluded from overall envelope.
cross_section_basis: New rear/end and barrel photos confirm rounded sections. Main section approximated as oval with flat face lands; front is circular at nominal 18 mm using an estimated 18 mm thickness, not a second measured diameter. Rear photo supports nominal 32 mm width; faint display is not used as a new precision measurement.
notes: Idealized photo-derived solid reference, not printable pump internals. Local X width, Y from nozzle tip towards rear, Z thickness; boss face +Z. Caliper beside the body is a scale reference, not an end-to-end measurement. All feature stations, thickness distribution, nozzle and elbow axes are estimates. Battery and switch remain external references. No close-fitting cradle should be inferred from this model.
